title: Every tile
description: A saved level holding every tile the level editor offers, five rows of them on brick floors, opens in the editor: blocks, ladders, trees and vines, water and lava, monsters, traps, treasure and items. Test plays it, and the monsters, traps and items come alive as the player walks in.
